text.description_html:
RK International CP-45, Deco Two-Toned Cabinet Pull

This cabinet pull is available in as oil rubbed bronze finish with a polished brass base or polished chrome finish with a polished brass base. The Deco Cabinet Pull With Polished Brass Accent brings to mind Miami's Art-Deco area. Its style can bring the fun feeling of Miami Beach to any home. It is easy to install with the included hardware. The Two Tone Decorative Ends Pull has a 3 inch center to center.

Also Available:
Matching Half-Round Deco Two-Toned Cabinet Knob
Matching Round Deco Cabinet Knob
Matching Square Deco Cabinet Knob

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-45 Retro Cabinet Pull with Brass Accent:

  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Length Overall: 3-3/4"
  • Width: 5/8"
  • Material: brass
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
